polls.description: Tech giants and sovereign nations are committing unprecedented billions to AI infrastructure, from SoftBank's $50B Malaysia investment to Meta's $95B raise and SpaceX's $40B GPU deal.
polls.question: Are these massive AI infrastructure investments visionary or reckless?

cluster_stories.title: SoftBank’s Masayoshi Son picks Malaysia for $50bn of AI investment, Anwar says
cluster_stories.summary: SoftBank founder Masayoshi Son has picked Malaysia for $50bn of investment in AI, new technology and data centres. Prime minister Anwar Ibrahim made the announcement on Saturday. Anwar said Son told him about the plan during a video call on Tuesday. He spoke in Malacca, at the launch of a national cost of living plan. […] This story continues at The Next Web
cluster_stories.headline: SoftBank's Son Picks Malaysia for $50B AI Investment

cluster_stories.title: SpaceX locks in $40B GPU financing deal with Apollo
cluster_stories.summary: SpaceX has locked in a binding commitment for roughly $40 billion in financing to pay for AI chips and related data center equipment, the company disclosed in a regulatory filing Monday. In a statement, SpaceX called it the “largest committed GPU financing” ever.
cluster_stories.headline: SPACEX LOCKS IN $40B GPU DEAL WITH APOLLO

cluster_stories.title: AI chip giant SK hynix says quarterly operating profit soars 630%
cluster_stories.summary: South Korean chip giant SK hynix said Wednesday its third-quarter operating profit soared 632 percent on-year, largely driven by the artificial intelligence industry's explosive demand for its advanced memory chips. The memory chip giant said it had posted record revenue and operating profit for six straight quarters since the second quarter of last year.
cluster_stories.headline: SK Hynix Profit SOARS 630% on AI Chip Demand

cluster_stories.title: SoftBank’s Son Plans $50 Billion Malaysia Tech Outlay, PM Says
cluster_stories.summary: Masayoshi Son of SoftBank Group Corp. chose locations in Malaysia for $50 billion in technology investments, the country’s prime minister said, an outlay that would accelerate the billionaire’s global bet on AI infrastructure.
cluster_stories.headline: SOFTBANK'S SON COMMITS $50B TO MALAYSIA TECH HUB

cluster_stories.title: Meta Looks to Raise $95 Billion From Stock Sale to Fund AI Investments
cluster_stories.summary: Meta Platforms Inc. is seeking to raise as much as $95 billion from selling common and preferred stock to support its development in artificial intelligence. Bloomberg's Sarah Frier reports. (Source: Bloomberg)
cluster_stories.headline: META RAISES $95 BILLION FOR AI INVESTMENTS

cluster_stories.title: Dallas firm Disruptive closes $10bn fund to back AI and defence startups
cluster_stories.summary: Disruptive, a venture capital firm based in Dallas, has raised a $10bn fund to invest in AI, defence and software startups, Bloomberg reported on Tuesday. The new money roughly doubles the assets the firm manages. Disruptive plans to back about 10 late-stage companies, putting around $1bn into each. Most of it will go into new funding […] This story continues at The Next Web
cluster_stories.headline: DISRUPTIVE CLOSES $10BN MEGAFUND FOR AI STARTUPS

cluster_stories.title: Disruptive Closes $10 Billion Megafund for AI, Defense Startups
cluster_stories.summary: The Dallas-based firm plans to back 10 later-stage companies with $1 billion each.
cluster_stories.headline: DISRUPTIVE RAISES $10BN FOR AI AND DEFENSE

polls.description: Growing tensions over AI chip exports to China as governments impose restrictions and seize shipments amid the global race for AI hardware dominance.
polls.question: Are AI chip export controls protecting security or hindering progress?

cluster_stories.title: Malaysia intercepted $12.2 million shipment of servers with AI chips suspected of violating export controls
cluster_stories.summary: Malaysia introduced permit requirements for shipping AI chips of U.S. origin last year, under pressure from the U.S. to prevent rerouting to China
cluster_stories.headline: Malaysia Seizes $12.2M AI Chip Shipment... Export Control Violation Suspected

cluster_stories.title: China's new export curbs draw a line around its AI crown jewels
cluster_stories.summary: The draft rules, released on October 16, distinguish between foreign customers using Chinese AI services and foreign companies obtaining the models, data or expertise needed to operate or reproduce them independently.
cluster_stories.headline: CHINA DRAWS LINE Around AI Crown Jewels With Export Curbs

cluster_stories.title: US DOJ is inquiring about Nvidia's purchase of Hugging Face
cluster_stories.summary: The Justice Department's recent questioning covers Nvidia's acquisitions, investments, sales practices, and whether the chip designer has exerted pressure on its customers, the two people said.
cluster_stories.headline: DOJ PROBES Nvidia's Hugging Face Purchase

cluster_stories.title: China’s CXMT will make AI memory despite yields as low as 20%, Reuters says
cluster_stories.summary: China’s biggest memory chipmaker, CXMT, plans to start making HBM3E, an advanced memory used in AI chips, even though only 20% to 30% of the chips it makes are usable. Two people familiar with the matter told Reuters, which reported the details on Wednesday, 28 October. TNW has not independently verified the report. CXMT has […] This story continues at The Next Web
cluster_stories.headline: China's CXMT to Make AI Memory Despite 20% Yields

polls.description: Tech giants and investors are committing tens of billions in capital to AI chips, data centers, and infrastructure in a global spending race.
